sit_minutes.label: Sitting stretch
sit_minutes.description: Minutes seated before the widget asks you to stand.

stand_minutes.label: Standing stretch
stand_minutes.description: Minutes standing before the widget asks you to sit. Shorter than the sitting stretch on purpose: a long static stand has its own cost.

stand_goal_minutes.label: Daily standing goal
stand_goal_minutes.description: Minutes of standing to aim for per day, shown as a running total in the tooltip. 0 hides the goal.

notify.label: Notify on switch
notify.description: Send one notification each time the posture changes. The bar text updates either way.

defer_during_meetings.label: Hold during meetings
defer_during_meetings.description: Delay a switch that falls inside a calendar event, so the nudge does not land mid-call. Needs the next-event helper; without it switches happen on time.

max_defer_minutes.label: Maximum hold
max_defer_minutes.description: Give up holding after this long and switch anyway. 0 waits for the meeting to end however long it runs.

warn_minutes.label: Warning window
warn_minutes.description: Minutes before a switch at which the widget turns urgent.

away_resets_minutes.label: Away resets the phase
away_resets_minutes.description: A gap between ticks longer than this means suspend or a long absence, so the current phase restarts instead of firing for time not spent at the desk. 0 disables.

show_remaining.label: Show remaining time
show_remaining.description: Print the time left in the bar next to the icon. Turn off for an icon-only widget.

tooltip.held_reason: waiting for the meeting to end
tooltip.hint: Left click: switch now · Right click: pause
